supersedes: browser-review.json origin-pinning finding; prior HOLD record remains unchanged as historical review
origin_review: Browser context blocks service workers and routes requests only to the exact HTTPS origins https://alisa.octoport.ru and https://id.octoport.ru; other requests are aborted and set a fatal flag.
Unexpected main-frame navigation sets a fatal flag; every subsequent sensitive step checks the approved exact origin and requires the flags to remain clear.

Identity origin is required before entering password, before submitting password, before reading/submitting email code, and after an incorrect-code response; Alisa origin is required after cabinet login before profile access.
Navigation evidence stores only allowed netloc and path, without query parameters or credentials.
retained_safe_boundaries: Fresh browser context; no prior session copy.
Reentry clears only the Alisa product cookie and confirms the same native Identity session remains.
Uses the existing reserved example.invalid fixture and a genuinely delivered mailbox code; the invalid code is checked before valid completion.
Cookies, password, email code, and identity values are not written to output. Browser state is bounded and stored under the configured private tmpfs path.
execution_prerequisites: Run only under the separately reviewed finite unit/resource envelope and private tmpfs setup described by the owner.
Use the existing root-owned mode-0600 fixture without printing or exporting its contents.
review_limits: Static read-only review only; script was not executed and fixture contents were not read.
No host calls, production DB access, account mutation, or test execution performed.
